copies.title: NH35 Automatic Watch, White Diver-Style Mod, 40 mm Steel Case
copies.short_description: A crisp white diver-style automatic watch with a Seiko NH35 movement, ceramic bezel, sapphire crystal and a 40 mm case in 316L stainless steel.

Each watch is hand-assembled around the Seiko NH35 automatic movement. The 40 mm case is made from 316L stainless steel, and the white ceramic bezel with black 60-minute markings frames a white dial with bold black indices and a date window at 3 o'clock.

review_notes: High legal risk, please check before publishing: the dial in the photos carries Rolex trademarks ("Oyster Perpetual Date", "Sea-Dweller", "Superlative Chronometer Officially Certified", the Rolex-style crown/coronet shape is not visible but the wording is), and the product name uses "Yacht Master" (Rolex trademark). Selling goods bearing another brand's marks can count as counterfeiting under the EU Trade Mark Regulation and may lead to customs seizure and claims. The copy deliberately avoids these names; consider a sterile or own-brand dial and renaming the product.

The dial also shows a "SEIKO" logo although the watch is a mod built by the shop, not a Seiko product. Referring to the Seiko NH35 movement is descriptive, but a Seiko logo on the dial and "Seiko Mod" in the product name may suggest Seiko origin. The copy only names Seiko in connection with the movement.

The dial features a stormtrooper helmet motif (Star Wars, Lucasfilm/Disney). Using this character and "Star Wars" in the product name without a licence is a trademark/copyright risk. Not mentioned in the copy; please confirm licensing or remove.

The dial prints "12800 ft = 3900 m" and "Superlative Chronometer Officially Certified". No facts support this depth rating or a chronometer certification; these printed claims could be misleading under the UCPD. Not repeated in the copy.
Water resistance: the shop only says "tested & approved" with no rating (e.g. 10 bar / 100 m). No water claim was made in the copy. Please provide the rated value if you want to mention it.
Strap material is not stated (photo looks like rubber or silicone). Copy only says "white strap"; please confirm the material.
Bezel rotation (unidirectional or bidirectional), crown type (screw-down or not) and lume are not stated, so they are not mentioned.
Removed from product copy: 1-year warranty and worldwide express shipping (shop-wide policies), and "premium look without luxury price" (comparative hype).
The brand field says "Watches", which is a category, not a brand. Please set the correct brand or shop name.

copies.title: Automatikuhr ganz in Schwarz, Seiko NH35 Mod mit Keramiklünette
copies.short_description: Komplett schwarze Automatikuhr mit Seiko-NH35-Werk, 40-mm-Gehäuse aus Edelstahl 316L, Keramiklünette, Saphirglas und Datumsfenster.
copies.description_html:
Eine komplett schwarze Automatikuhr, die sich durch die Bewegung Ihres Handgelenks aufzieht, ganz ohne Batteriewechsel. Mit 40 mm Durchmesser und 12 mm Höhe passt sie bequem unter die Manschette, und das klare schwarze Zifferblatt mit Datumsfenster bei 3 Uhr lässt sich auf einen Blick ablesen.

Technische Daten

  • Uhrwerk: Seiko NH35 Automatik
  • Gehäuse: Edelstahl 316L, schwarze Ausführung, 40 mm Durchmesser, 12 mm Höhe
  • Lünette: Keramik, mit Minutenskala
  • Glas: Saphirglas, entspiegelt
  • Armband: schwarz, verstellbar für Handgelenke von 14,5 bis 22 cm
  • Von Hand montiert

Das Saphirglas ist kratzfest, und dank der Entspiegelung bleibt das Zifferblatt auch bei hellem Licht gut lesbar. Eine Automatikuhr läuft am genauesten, wenn Sie sie regelmäßig tragen. Ist sie nach ein paar Tagen ohne Tragen stehen geblieben, stellen Sie die Uhrzeit neu ein und legen Sie sie an: Das Werk zieht sich beim Tragen selbst auf.

review_notes: High legal risk: the product name uses 'Yacht Master' and the dial in the photo shows Rolex trademarks ('Oyster Perpetual Date', 'Sea-Dweller', 'Superlative Chronometer Officially Certified'). Selling a watch bearing third-party trademarks can be treated as counterfeiting under EU trademark law. The copy deliberately avoids these names; please have the product and its name checked before listing, and consider renaming it (e.g. 'Seiko NH35 Mod All Black').

The dial shows a Star Wars stormtrooper helmet motif and the product name uses 'Star Wars'. This is Lucasfilm/Disney IP; unless the shop holds a licence, remove the name and do not promote the motif. The copy does not mention it.

The 'SEIKO' logo on the dial suggests the watch is made by Seiko. Only the NH35 movement is a Seiko component. The copy refers to 'Seiko NH35 movement' and the common term 'Seiko mod'; confirm this is acceptable or drop 'Seiko' from title and SEO fields.

The dial carries a 'Superlative Chronometer Officially Certified' print and a depth rating. No chronometer certification or water resistance rating is in the facts, so these printed claims are misleading (UCPD). Not used in the copy.
'Waterproof: tested & approved' gives no rating. Water resistance was left out; please supply the actual rating (e.g. 5 ATM / 10 ATM, ISO standard) if you want it mentioned.
Strap material is not stated; the facts say 'bracelet' while the photo shows what looks like a rubber strap. Copy says only 'black strap'. Please confirm material.
The black case finish method (PVD, DLC, coating) is not stated. Copy says 'black finish' only.
Unknown and therefore not mentioned: bezel rotation (unidirectional or not), luminous hands/markers, power reserve, crown type.
Removed shop-wide content from the original text: 1-year warranty and worldwide express shipping. Also removed 'Premium look without luxury price' and 'built to last' as unsupported marketing claims.
The Brand field reads 'Watches', which looks like a category rather than a brand. Please check.
